sentence: The course aims to develop students' ability to understand, design and implement programmes in C language, applying structured programming principles.

The aim is for students to become autonomous in the use of Unix/Linux environments, master the process of compilation and execution via command line, and understand the complete software development cycle.

By the end of the course, students should be able to analyse problems, break down solutions into functions and modules, use control structures, arrays, pointers, strings and data structures appropriately, and manipulate files and dynamic memory.
The course also aims to foster good practices in organisation, documentation and code testing, promoting the rigour and clarity essential to engineering programming.
The C Programming course introduces the fundamentals of structured programming, integrating the use of Unix/Linux systems and command line compilation.
The essential concepts of the C language are covered: programme structure, data types, operators and flow control.
Skills are developed in modularisation with functions, use of arrays, pointers, strings and structures (struct).
It also includes working with text and binary files, command line arguments and dynamic memory, culminating in the organisation of programmes in multiple files using make.

The course aims to provide students with a solid foundation for understanding, developing and testing small and medium complexity programmes in C, applying good practices of readability and efficiency.
Develop algorithms for the solution of specific problems
Implement programs and scripts using a programming language
Do debugging of computer programs

The teaching methodology associated with the curricular unit will be based on a problem-based learning approach, with theoretical-practical classes involving the exposure of different programmatic concepts, and the autonomous resolution of practical problems for consolidation of knowledge.

In the end, students should have skills in the domain of web technologies, allowing them to understand, intervene and collaborate in the web development process, so that it can be adapted for digital marketing, when used this means of communication.
Web design main elements, using HTML
Web design customization, using CSS and Twitter Bootstrap
JavaScript programming language
Programming DOM elements
Information representation obtained in JSON.
This micro-credential aims to equip students with a set of skills that are not only relevant but also indispensable in today's technology-driven scenario.
